description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData to query the real-time back-to-origin bandwidth data for an accelerated domain name
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData查询域名实时回源带宽数据
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeSrcBpsData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个域名用逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

DataInterval.description_en:
The time interval between data points, in seconds.

The value of this parameter is fixed. It can be 60 (1 minute), 300 (5 minutes), or 3600 (1 hour), depending on the maximum time range of a single query. For more information, see the data granularity details in the Usage notes
DataInterval.description_zh:
每条记录的时间间隔，以秒为单位。

根据单次查询的最大时间跨度不同，该参数固定返回60（1分钟）、300（5分钟）或3600（1小时），具体请参见使用说明中返回数据时间粒度

EndTime.description_en: The end of the time range

StartTime.description_en: The beginning of the time range
